subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR receive a proof override for a provider-side xAI stale encrypted_content rotation that the contributor says cannot be induced on demand?
rationale: External PR policy normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the code path is narrow, the trigger appears provider-owned, and the PR has pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative tests.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs plus focused predicate coverage as enough for this non-inducible recovery path, then merge once normal checks and rebase pass.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix evidence
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future xAI rotation produces redacted logs showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Ask for maintainer-run validation
options.body: Have an owner with xAI access attempt the closest safe gateway validation before deciding whether to override the proof gate.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs plus focused predicate coverage as enough for this non-inducible recovery path, then merge once normal checks and rebase pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available owner because the prior merged encrypted-content retry predicate work was authored there and this is a proof-policy call on the same recovery path.
